title: Task
empty: Send {{name}} a message to start this Task.
offline: The Machine is offline. Send once it's back.
busy: You can send once this Turn ends
queued: This Turn is running. Your message will wait for it to end.

budget.body: New work starts at 04:00 in {{machine}}'s time, or when you add Budget. Files it changed are still there.

approval.title: {{name}} wants to run this
approval.closed: Its Turn ended before anyone answered
approval.notInAllowlist: Not in the Allowlist. If nobody answers before it expires, it counts as denied.
approval.steer: Tell it what to do instead
approval.covers: Trim the end to leave the prefix you mean. This entry covers every command that starts that way.
approval.doesNotCover: This does not cover the command, so it still asks.

interrupted.title: {{machine}} started again mid-Turn
interrupted.body: The files it changed are still there, and {{name}} won't carry on by itself, because it could run the same command twice

stop.title: Stop this Turn?

authenticate.always: Add {{entries}} to the Allowlist and approve
